input.question: Which line is Belorussky a station on?

documents.text: Prospekt Mira (Russian: Проспе́кт Ми́ра) is a station of the Moscow Metro's Belorusskaya line. Opened on 30 January 1952 as part of the second stage of the line, it is a pylon design by architects Vladimir Gelfreykh and Mikhail Minkus.
